==Hero Usage==
* Heroes will only use this enchantment while in combat.

== Notes ==
* "Create" includes spawning [[minion]]s, [[Asura summon]]s, and [[Ebon Vanguard Assassin Support|Ebon Vanguard Assassin]].
* Synergy with skills that can create multiple [[summoned creature]]s, since this skill triggers when each creature is created.
** This skill will trigger simultaneously for each creature created when using [[Animate Bone Minions]], [[Aura of the Lich]], or [[Signet of Spirits]].
** Using [[Animate Shambling Horror]] will trigger this skill two times eventually: once when the [[Shambling Horror]] is animated, and then once again when it dies and a [[Jagged Horror]] is spawned.
** Jagged Horrors created via [[Jagged Bones]] will trigger this skill.

== Trivia ==
